title: Wedge follows the room fader

complaints.says: You turned me down in the room for the prayer, and now I can barely hear myself in my wedge.

win.label: Vox 1 stays down in the room
win.hint: Leave the Vox 1 fader down. Change how Mix 1 picks up its sends instead.

hints: The wedge got quieter when the room fader came down. What decides whether a monitor send follows the fader?
cause: Mix 1 (the leader's wedge) was set to post-fader, so pulling Vox 1 down in the room also pulled it down in the wedge.
lesson: Monitor mixes should be pre-fader, so the room mix and the wedges stay independent. Post-fader sends are for effects like reverb.
